notes.title: Pasvan version 0.24
notes.notes: Hello everyone, we've decided to do something for our Mac users over the past few years, and we're proud to announce that we've released Pasvan Mac support :) Also, we've changed the ever-changing maze walls to even mooore changing walls, of course it's all for you :) and a few bug fixes

notes.title: Patch 0.21
notes.notes:
Hello There ! 

After 2 years there are bunch of news about PASVAN and we are so happy to publish this update !

Keep going ! Have a nice one !
